identity.one_line: A bard-commander using Tempo, songs, banners, drums, and party auras. It contributes damage while maintaining Battle Bard effects and choosing the right manuscript, march, or banner for the encounter. Its strength is group amplification, but personal rotation and raid-buff timing compete for attention.

mechanics.core_loop: A bard-commander using Tempo, songs, banners, drums, and party auras. It contributes damage while maintaining Battle Bard effects and choosing the right manuscript, march, or banner for the encounter. Its strength is group amplification, but personal rotation and raid-buff timing compete for attention.

modes.name: Inspiring Leader
modes.structural_description: You pledge to inspire your allies in the midst of battle, transforming your Pulverize and your Broad Sweep into Ballads.

modes.name: Tempo
modes.structural_description: Level 10 PassiveCasting Ballads now grants Tempo, stacking 3 times. Upon reaching 3 stacks of Tempo, you consume them to perform a Sound of War, striking all enemies within 8 yds for 71 + 12.74% AP Magic damage.Tempo (Proc)Critical strike chance increased by 2%, stacking 3 times.

modes.name: Banner Boy
modes.structural_description: Increases your haste by 5% and the movement speed granted by Line Formation by 8%.

modes.name: Dissonance
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by Sound of War now has a 25% chance to reduce enemies' resistances by 75 and increases their Magic damage taken by -2% for 8 seconds.

modes.name: Battle Drums
modes.structural_description: Place down 3 Battle Drums around you for 1 minute. Allies may click on the drums to increase their critical strike chance, haste, damage, and healing done by 10% and causes their damage dealt to trigger a Sound of War for their next 5 instances of damage or 30 seconds.

modes.name: War Drums
modes.structural_description: Adds 5% to the value of Echoes of War.In addition, performing a Sound of War now has a 40% chance to echo, striking an additional time after 0.5 sec. Can only occur once per sec.

modes.name: Field Commander
modes.structural_description: Placing a Standard causes your next Song of Steel to unleash an additional unique effect.SpellwardingIncreases the magic resistance of party and raid members within 100 yds by 20 for 10 seconds.MightReduces the Armor of enemies within 100 yds by -15% for 10 seconds.RallyingIncreases the movement speed of party and raid members within 100 yds by 15% for 10 seconds.RecoveryReduces the melee and ranged attack speed of enemies within 100 yds by -10% for 10 seconds.
